Publication statement: New Orleans, LA : Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement Gulf of Mexico OCS Region, 2015.

This dataset contains surface locations for oil and gas wells located in the Gulf of Mexico federal waters. Note that the wells are being added or modified continuously; obtaining updates of this database are required to know the true distribution of well data. The dataset contains the well surface locations as of March 2015--from metadata file.
